first_passage.population: Exactly the saved selection pairs; no recognition or rematching

first_passage.continuation: E+(E-L); inclusive touches; next candle through12bars
first_passage.missing_or_boundary: unresolved unless first passage already known; never drop
first_passage.weighting: Saved equal completion-moment pair weights; renormalize within reporting view
first_passage.contrast: Weighted case minus control fractions for each of all four classes

progress.full_window: Includes after failure; never reclassifies original first passage
progress.pre_failure_bounds: Lower: strictly earlier candle highs; upper: also first failure candle high; include zero anchor
progress.intrabar_order: Unknown; bounds rather than invented high/low ordering
progress.censoring: Partial path observed maximum is a lower bound, excluded from complete-window distribution with count and original mass retained
progress.quantile_definition: Smallest value whose cumulative original weight reaches p times group mass; no interpolation
progress.weights: Original pair weights, normalized only in explicitly named reporting group
progress.interpretation: Post-outcome descriptive only; no prediction, inference, optimized target or beyond-three-hour claim

measurement_rules.outcome_provenance: Computed in this Check and passed directly to the unchanged progress kernel
measurement_rules.reporting: Whole saved scope and its declared populations;original root weights normalized only within each named reporting view
